reading_shown: On SPY: how often the direction of the first 60-minute candle matches the rest of the session after it.
headline: The first 60-minute candle matched the direction of the rest of the session 51.8% of the time, about what two unrelated directions would give.
what_happened: If the two directions were unrelated they would match about 50.3% of the time; the measured rate's likely range is 49.9% to 53.7%.
Simply guessing "up" every day would have matched the rest of the session 54.9% of the time, which is better than following the candle.

reading_shown: On SPY: how often it trades above the previous session's high at some point.
headline: SPY traded above the previous session's high at some point on 4,579 of 8,515 sessions (53.8%), from February 1, 1993 to November 27, 2026.
what_happened: On the other 3,936 sessions it did not.

reading_shown: On SPY: when the session's high was made, in 30-minute parts of the session.
headline: SPY made its high of the day between 09:30 and 10:00 on 24.4% of sessions, more than any other half hour; the next most common was 15:30–16:00 (23.3%).
what_happened: If the high could fall anywhere, each part of the day would hold about 7.7%.
Counted on 2,741 sessions from Jan 2016 to Nov 2026 (New York time).
